duration: As stated in the agreement or to be refined in review.
effective_date: Upon full execution by the parties unless otherwise specified.
payment_terms: To be agreed between the parties (add specifics in review if compensation applies).
purpose: I own a growing independent fitness brand with online coaching, supplements, and live events, and a big creator just offered to partner with us fast because they want to launch a co-branded transformation program before summer. Right now everything is voice notes, DMs, and hype, and I need a real agreement between my company and their team. We’d be using both brands, their audience, our staff, our training systems, and shared marketing spend. Need clear revenue split on memberships, upsells, merch, and supplement sales, who controls Stripe/accounts and payout timing, ownership of videos/content/customer lists created during the partnership, approval rights on ads and messaging, use of each person’s likeness/name/image, minimum posting obligations, launch deadlines, refund responsibility, chargebacks, FTC compliance for testimonials/claims, exclusivity in fitness niche, non-solicit of coaches/employees, confidentiality around numbers and customer data, what happens if one side gets canceled or public scandal hits, early termination rights, who keeps recurring subscribers after breakup, dispute resolution, governing law, and a clean process so both sides can revise together then send for tracked e-sign once finalized.
title: Agreement
